hairstyles.name: Textured French Crop
hairstyles.description: Short forward fringe with textured crown layers and a clean low-to-mid fade on the sides. Accentuates bone structure without high daily maintenance.
stylingTips: Apply matte styling powder or clay into damp or dry hair
Pinch sections forward to enhance natural piecey separation

hairstyles.name: Classic Tapered Side Part
hairstyles.description: Timeless gentleman’s silhouette with defined part line, scissor-tapered temples, and disciplined combed cadence.
stylingTips: Locate natural cowlick or off-center parting line
Comb through using light pomade or styling cream with low sheen

hairstyles.name: Fluid Middle Part (Curtains)
hairstyles.description: Flowing medium-length partition framing cheekbones with soft natural taper toward the nape. Iconic Korean and 90s editorial aesthetic.
stylingTips: Blow-dry roots upward at the center part to build natural lift
Seal ends with lightweight argan oil or airy paste

hairstyles.name: Architectural Buzz Cut
hairstyles.description: Uniform clip with razor-precise temple fade and crisp hairline edges. Spotlights facial bone structure with zero daily effort.
stylingTips: Zero daily styling required
Keep scalp hydrated with lightweight botanical oil

hairstyles.name: Wavy Shaggy Mod Cut
hairstyles.description: Layered vintage shag with textured perimeter over the ears and soft brow-skimming fringe. Rich indie patina.
stylingTips: Air dry with sea salt spray for lived-in wavy definition
Scrunch gently; avoid stiff gels or high heat

hairstyles.name: Deconstructed Quiff
hairstyles.description: Upward sweep with textured separation and soft tapered sides. Adds vertical balance to facial geometry.
stylingTips: Pre-style with sea salt spray while blow-drying backward and upward
Finish with low-shine clay for flexible all-day hold

hairstyles.name: Slick Back Undercut
hairstyles.description: Smooth backward sweep with high contrast skin taper or disconnected undercut. Sharp, disciplined elegance.
stylingTips: Comb backward through damp strands with water-soluble pomade
Ensure side taper is serviced bi-weekly to maintain clean edge

hairstyles.name: Curly High Top Taper
hairstyles.description: Controlled spherical crown of defined curls balanced by gradient temple and neck taper. Celebrates natural coiled texture.
stylingTips: Apply leave-in curl cream to wet curls and allow to diffuse
Never brush dry curls to maintain defined spiral structure

hairstyles.name: Shoulder-Length Flow
hairstyles.description: Cascading natural layers tucked behind the ears. Free-spirited, editorial nonchalance.
stylingTips: Apply light smoothing serum mid-lengths to ends
Tuck behind ear on one side to open up facial geometry

hairstyles.name: Ivy League Crew Cut
hairstyles.description: Refined crew cut with enough length at the front to part or brush to the side. Subtle collegiate pedigree.
stylingTips: Finger comb a nickel-sized amount of light wax through crown
Angle front crest subtly upward and to the side

hairstyles.name: Architectural Wolf Cut
hairstyles.description: Deconstructed mullet-shag hybrid with crown volume, tapered choppy sides, and feathered nape drape.
stylingTips: Layer dry texture spray into crown for volumetric lift
Piece out nape tendrils with styling paste

hairstyles.name: Modern Comb Over Fade
hairstyles.description: Directional diagonal comb over paired with a refined low skin drop fade. Bridges modern edge with executive polish.
stylingTips: Guide along natural growth pattern using wide-tooth comb
Use matte paste to avoid greasy shine

hairstyles.name: Short Sculpted Locs with Taper
hairstyles.description: Precision cylindrical locs sculpted at brow level, flanked by sharp gradient temple and neck taper.
stylingTips: Maintain scalp nourishment with jojoba or tea tree oils
Palm roll loc roots regularly for clean cylindrical integrity

hairstyles.name: Blunt Forward Crop
hairstyles.description: Horizontal architectural fringe cut with zero taper at brow, paired with skin-tight drop fade. High runway impact.
stylingTips: Blow-dry flat downwards with paddle brush
Requires bi-weekly perimeter trimmer maintenance to preserve line

hairstyles.name: Classic Caesar Cut
hairstyles.description: Uniform horizontal short fringe with scissor-shortened sides. Subtle historical simplicity that gracefully handles maturing hairlines.
stylingTips: Towel dry and comb forward with fingertip swipe of matte balm
Ideal camouflage for maturing hairlines

hairstyles.name: Executive Pompadour
hairstyles.description: Sweeping frontal roll with substantial height, brushed back at sides into a tailored taper.
stylingTips: Round brush blow-dry with root lifter is non-negotiable
Finish with medium-hold pliable pomade

hairstyles.name: Architectural Knot with Undercut
hairstyles.description: Long crown gathered into a disciplined compact knot at occipital bone, anchored by clean faded temples and nape.
stylingTips: Gather hair when 90% dry using a snag-free elastic band
Smooth flyaways with botanical pomade stick

hairstyles.name: Textured Casual Waves
hairstyles.description: Mid-length unforced waves with subtle layering that falls naturally around cheekbones and collar.
stylingTips: Apply curl defining lotion onto damp hair and let air-dry
Avoid high-heat blow-dryers to prevent frizz

hairstyles.name: Mid-Length Box Braids
hairstyles.description: Square-parted individual braids falling to collarbone level. Exceptional versatility with low daily maintenance.
stylingTips: Moisturize scalp with braid spray containing aloe and peppermint
Sleep with satin bonnet to prevent friction frizz

hairstyles.name: Geometric Cornrows with Taper
hairstyles.description: Sleek scalp-braided linear cornrows leading backward, framed by razor-sharp temple and neckline taper.
stylingTips: Keep edges nourished with lightweight castor oil serum
Retouch edge taper every two weeks for geometric crispness

hairstyles.name: Defined Two-Strand Twists
hairstyles.description: Rope-twisted sections with defined ends and rich dimensional texture. Soft, organic drape with high moisture retention.
stylingTips: Twist wet using shea butter or curling custard for defined hold
Can be untwisted after 1-2 weeks into a voluminous twist-out

hairstyles.name: Sculpted Afro with Low Taper
hairstyles.description: Rounded cloud silhouette of natural dense coils gently shaped with shears, grounded by low temple and nape skin fade.
stylingTips: Pick out coils gently using wide wooden afro pick when damp
Hydrate daily with water-based leave-in mist

hairstyles.name: Architectural Blunt Bob
hairstyles.description: Razor-straight chin-length perimeter cut with crisp weight line and zero layering. High editorial geometry.
stylingTips: Flat iron with heat protector for glass-hair finish
Trim every 4-6 weeks to preserve sharp horizontal perimeter

hairstyles.name: Long Layered Shag with Curtain Bangs
hairstyles.description: Cascading feather-cut layers past collarbone paired with cheekbone-framing soft fringe. Effortless 70s rock aesthetic.
stylingTips: Diffuse naturally with sea salt spray for lived-in movement
Blow-dry fringe forward then flick outwards with round brush

hairstyles.name: Sculpted Tapered Pixie
hairstyles.description: Close scissor-cut nape and sides with piecey textured crown layers sweeping forward or to the side. Crisp, confident minimalism.
stylingTips: Work fingertip of lightweight matte wax through dry crown
Smooth sideburns flat against temples

hairstyles.name: Long Mature Dreadlocks
hairstyles.description: Chest-length mature uniform locs with natural cylindrical weight. Rich cultural heritage and statuesque presence.
stylingTips: Wash bi-weekly with residue-free clarifying shampoo
Air dry thoroughly to prevent moisture buildup in loc core

hairstyles.name: Disconnected Undercut with Flow
hairstyles.description: Long scissor-cut top left flowing loosely over tight clippered sides and back. High visual contrast between sleek sides and textured crown.
stylingTips: Sweep top to preferred side with light styling cream
Maintain clipper fade every 10-14 days

hairstyles.name: Curly Fringe Crop with Low Drop Fade
hairstyles.description: Short forward curly cluster falling over forehead with low skin drop fade behind ears. Highly popular contemporary silhouette.
stylingTips: Scrunch curl mousse into damp top and let air dry
Do not towel-rub harshly to preserve curl definition

hairstyles.name: Soft Side-Swept Medium Layers
hairstyles.description: Gentle diagonal sweep across forehead with soft scissor-cut taper over ears and nape. Understated academic poise.
stylingTips: Towel dry and comb diagonally with fingertips and light cream
Very forgiving on days without styling product

hairstyles.name: Defined Coily Taper (Short Wash & Go)
hairstyles.description: Compact 1-2 inch coiled curls defined with hydrating custard, accented with soft graduated temple fade.
stylingTips: Apply curling jelly to soaking wet hair and shake gently
Air dry or sit under hooded dryer for frizz-free spiral definition

beards.name: Clean Shaven
beards.description: Completely bare skin spotlighting natural jawline contour, lip line, and facial symmetry.
groomingTips: Exfoliate prior to wet shave using sharp double-edge safety razor
Finish with alcohol-free soothing aftershave balm

beards.name: Designer Stubble (3-Day Shadow)
beards.description: Even 1-3mm stubble providing subtle shadow and jawline definition without adding bulk.
groomingTips: Trim twice weekly with a 1.5mm to 2mm guard
Fade neckline just above Adam’s apple to maintain intentionality

beards.name: Heavy Stubble (5-Day Shadow)
beards.description: 4-5mm dense stubble offering strong jaw darkening and masculine texture while remaining clean and modern.
groomingTips: Edge upper cheekline cleanly with a precision blade
Apply daily hydrating beard oil to prevent scratchy bristle texture

beards.name: Short Boxed Beard
beards.description: Neatly trimmed full beard kept around 10-15mm with crisp cheek boundaries and a sculpted squared chin line.
groomingTips: Square off lower corners below jawline to add masculine angularity
Comb through daily with boar-bristle brush

beards.name: Tapered Fade Beard
beards.description: Blended beard starting at skin level by sideburns and grading into denser bulk along jaw and chin.
groomingTips: Service sideburn fade simultaneously with haircut
Use beard balm for edge discipline

beards.name: Extended Sculpted Goatee
beards.description: Combined mustache and chin beard extending along the jawline with cleanly shaven cheeks. Draws vertical focus down center.
groomingTips: Keep cheek areas razor-smooth to maintain contrast
Trim mustache corners just slightly below lip line

beards.name: Full Rugged Beard
beards.description: Dense natural full growth (25-40mm) kept shaped and conditioned without overly rigid razor lines.
groomingTips: Condition with warm beard wash and rich jojoba/argan oils daily
Blow-dry downwards on low heat while brushing to tame stray hairs

beards.name: Balbo & Anchor Beard
beards.description: Soul patch and chin beard shaped like an anchor, accompanied by an unattached trimmed mustache and bare cheeks.
groomingTips: Separate mustache from chin beard by at least 2mm clean margin
Requires steady hand with single-blade detailing trimmer

beards.name: Ducktail Shaped Beard
beards.description: Full beard with closely tapered cheek hair tapering down to a distinct point at center of chin.
groomingTips: Direct growth toward center chin point using round brush and wax
Creates vertical emphasis along lower facial line

beards.name: Refined Chevron Mustache with Stubble
beards.description: Prominent full chevron mustache over upper lip supported by subtle 1mm stubble along jaw.
groomingTips: Trim mustache horizontally just above top lip line
Maintain faint jaw shadow to ground the mustache prominence

beards.name: Corporate Low-Cut Beard
beards.description: Disciplined 6-8mm uniform beard clipped closely with razor-sharp cheekline and pristine neckline 1 inch above Adam’s apple.
groomingTips: Trim every 3-4 days with an 8mm guard
Comb straight down with sandalwood comb before shaving edges

beards.name: Classic Circular Goatee
beards.description: Continuous circular ring of mustache joining a compact chin beard, leaving the jawline and cheeks completely bare.
groomingTips: Shape circular perimeter when dry using foil shaver
Keep cheek areas polished and bare daily

beards.name: Sleek Pencil Mustache
beards.description: Ultra-thin horizontal line clipped just above vermilion border of upper lip, with fully clean-shaven face. Vintage Golden Age cinema flair.
groomingTips: Shave gap between nose and mustache with detail razor
Requires daily perimeter maintenance

beards.name: Handlebar Mustache with Bare Cheeks
beards.description: Full dense mustache with extended curled upward tips held by botanical wax, paired with clean-shaven or short stubble cheeks.
groomingTips: Train tips outward from center parting with stiff mustache wax
Never trim center hairs; comb them sideways into ends

beards.name: Micro Shadow (1-Day Scruff)
beards.description: Subtle 0.5mm shadow providing faint tonal contrast across lower face without formal beard presence.
groomingTips: Shave daily with electric foil trimmer without guard
Hydrate with non-greasy matte face moisturizer

beards.name: Modern Sculpted Chin Strap
beards.description: Disciplined narrow band of facial hair tracing jawline from sideburns to chin, leaving upper lip and cheeks bare.
groomingTips: Keep upper boundary exactly along mandibular angle
Requires bi-weekly razor edge definition

beards.name: Natural Walrus Mustache
beards.description: Heavy bushy mustache cascading down over upper lip in vintage counterculture cadence, accompanied by clean jaw.
groomingTips: Comb straight down with fine-tooth mustache comb daily
Condition ends with drops of jojoba oil to prevent bristle dryness

beards.name: Clean Shaven with Gradient Sideburn Taper
beards.description: Clean bare face transitioning seamlessly into high-precision gradient skin taper at temporal bone.
groomingTips: Service sideburn fade simultaneously with haircut
Wet shave cheeks every morning with botanical shaving cream

beards.name: Sculpted Horseshoe Mustache
beards.description: Full mustache with vertical pipes extending down past corners of mouth to jawline, cheeks and chin clean.
groomingTips: Shave chin center with precision single edge
Keep vertical legs parallel to corner mouth vertical

beards.name: Natural Chin Curtain
beards.description: Beard following jawline and covering entire chin without mustache. Distinct historical and artistic silhouette.
groomingTips: Shave upper lip clean every two days
Keep jawline margin symmetrical on both sides

styles.name: Minimal
styles.editorialSubtitle: Purity of line, stripped-back utility, monochrome quietude.
styles.description: Focuses on unadorned silhouettes, immaculate tailoring, and a restrained monochromatic or tonal palette.
antiSignals: heavily distressed fabrics or raw frayed hems
excessive ornamental hardware, chains, or studs

styles.name: Korean Minimal
styles.editorialSubtitle: Fluid drapery, soft neutral harmonies, dropped shoulder softness.
styles.description: Blends Scandinavian restraint with Seoul streetwear proportions—oversized fluid drape, soft ecru/sage tones, and intentional volume play.
antiSignals: skinny spray-on denim or tapered joggers
corporate executive ties or formal evening studs

styles.name: Smart Casual
styles.editorialSubtitle: Tailored versatility, refined textures, effortless transition.
styles.description: Effortlessly bridges executive sharpness and casual ease through structured knitwear, relaxed trousers, and deconstructed blazers.
antiSignals: athletic gymwear, track pants, or graphic hoodies
extreme deconstructed distressing or raw hems
black-tie evening tuxedos or opera pumps
tactical molle webbing or heavy cargo pouches

styles.name: Old Money
styles.editorialSubtitle: Subdued heritage, collegiate poise, timeless noble fabrication.
styles.description: Rooted in bespoke generational elegance—cable-knit cashmere, pleats, signet rings, rich navy blazers, and loafers with quiet pedigree.
antiSignals: loud streetwear graphics and logo tees
chunky rubber platform soles or foam slip-ons

styles.name: Streetwear
styles.editorialSubtitle: Cultural resonance, graphic proportions, sneaker-led visual syntax.
styles.description: High-impact volumetric silhouettes inspired by skate, hip-hop, and youth subcultures. Characterized by heavyweight jerseys and statement footwear.
antiSignals: stiff corporate suiting ties or dinner jackets
high-heeled patent stilettos or formal opera pumps

styles.name: Workwear
styles.editorialSubtitle: Rugged resilience, utilitarian stitching, enduring indigo and canvas.
styles.description: Heavy-gauge heritage clothing built for endurance—chore coats, selvedge denim, double-knee duck canvas, and oiled leather work boots.
antiSignals: fragile liquid silk or sheer chiffon

styles.name: Techwear
styles.editorialSubtitle: Ergonomic utility, performance membranes, dystopian cybernetic precision.
styles.description: Aestheticized technical utility featuring weatherproof membranes, modular webbing, articulated joints, and monochromatic stealth.
antiSignals: vintage hand-knit cable sweaters or tweed blazers
romantic floral prints or pastel ruffles
delicate thin-soled loafers or suede espadrilles

styles.name: Dark Academia
styles.editorialSubtitle: Melancholic scholasticism, autumnal wools, romantic historical layering.
styles.description: Romantic vintage scholasticism celebrating classic literature, heavy woolen tweeds, trench coats, argyle knits, and burnished leather brogues.
antiSignals: futuristic techwear webbing or metallic accents

styles.name: Vintage
styles.editorialSubtitle: Archival nostalgia, patina garments, counter-trend silhouettes.
styles.description: Curated mid-to-late 20th century garments chosen for character, unique aging, nostalgic cuts, and subversive juxtaposition.

styles.name: Experimental
styles.editorialSubtitle: Deconstructive geometry, boundary-pushing drapery, avant-garde disruption.
styles.description: Subverts conventional fashion rules through asymmetric cuts, distorted proportions, raw edges, and unconventional texture combinations.

occasions.name: Job Interview
guidelines: Prioritize structured tailoring and restrained color discipline
Ensure grooming is pristine, hair disciplined, and collar crisp
Avoid loud logos, excessive jewelry, and casual sneakers

occasions.name: Modern Office / Workplace
guidelines: Balance comfort and professional authority
Knit polos, tailored trousers, clean derbies or minimal leather sneakers
Neutral and earth tones communicate competence and calm

occasions.name: Everyday Casual / Weekend
guidelines: Effortless silhouettes with high breathability and walkability
Boxy cut tees, relaxed chinos, unbuttoned lightweight overshirts

occasions.name: Fine Dining / Dinner Party
guidelines: Sophisticated layering, structured outerwear, and immaculate footwear
Drape and fabric texture are paramount under warm ambient restaurant lighting

occasions.name: Evening Date
guidelines: Focus on tactile textures (merino, suede, brushed cotton) that invite closeness
Silhouette should look intentional and well-proportioned without looking over-stiff
Elevate through dark palette anchoring (black, charcoal, deep navy, rich brown)

occasions.name: Night Out / Lounge / Club
guidelines: Embrace edge, contrast, and darker moody tones
Strong silhouette: cropped leather jackets, relaxed wide trousers, or statement boots
Jewelry and subtle accessories can take center stage

occasions.name: Social Gathering / House Party
guidelines: Expressive styling with conversation-starter silhouettes or textures
High mobility and effortless self-assured presence

occasions.name: University / College Campus
guidelines: Comfort-driven layered casual with strong proportions
Heavyweight hoodies under work jackets, relaxed denim, timeless sneakers

occasions.name: Wedding Guest
guidelines: Honor ceremonial formality without overshadowing the hosts
Never wear all-white; choose rich navy, charcoal, or refined earthy linen suits
Pair with polished oxfords or dress loafers

occasions.name: Cultural / Traditional Ceremony
guidelines: Honors heritage textiles, bespoke regional drapery, and ceremonial reverence
Welcomes sherwani, kurta, bandhgala, barong tagalog, hanbok, kimono, bespoke linen tunics, and cultural formalwear
System does NOT default automatically to Western business suiting when cultural context is selected

occasions.name: Airport / Travel Transit
guidelines: Wrinkle-resistant fabrics, functional layers for temperature shifts
Easy slip-on footwear and ergonomic relaxed trousers

occasions.name: Custom Curated Event
guidelines: Adaptable contextual configuration based on custom user specification
